text:
maria: Kicking off Lazuli private/VPC week0 recap. Short: core infra mostly green, key outstanding asks are: firewall peering acceptance, HSM-backed KMS proof, and 7-year immutable audit retention question. Listing owners below 

jonah: Networking snapshot: TGW attached, route propagation enabled, private subnets have flow logs. Waiting on customer firewall to accept peering and provide BGP ASN for transit tunnels. Filed INF-4442 for the handoff.

tara: Security/KMS: customer requires HSM origin CMK (FIPS requirement) + rotation cadence and per-request usage audit. I'll produce a concise KMS policy sample and a checklist of acceptable HSM evidence (CloudHSM certs or third-party HSM attestation).

nina: Audit logging: customer wants logs to land in their Splunk with a 7-year immutable requirement. Options: object-lock WORM S3 with access controls or a hybrid export + notarized attestation. Need their expected monthly ingest GB to size costs.

alex: Renewal note: 7y immutability is higher risk than our baseline. I'm flagging this in the account health and will coordinate legal/pricing. Proposing two customer-facing options: (A) native WORM add-on for 7y, (B) 3y standard + paid archival plus signed attestations.

maria: Action items: jonah -> chase firewall acceptance + push INF-4442 update (owner: jonah, due Wed EOD). tara -> post KMS policy draft + HSM evidence checklist (owner: tara, due Thu noon). nina -> request Splunk ingest estimates and HEC endpoint details from customer (owner: nina, due Thu EOD). alex -> update renewal-risk scorecard and loop legal/pricing, schedule sync for Friday 9am PT (owner: alex). CS bot make follow-ups.

cs_bot: Created CS-9123 "Lazuli week0 follow-ups: peering, KMS HSM evidence, audit retention" assigned to alex.

jonah: Quick check command I used to validate flow logs: `aws ec2 describe-flow-logs --filter Name=resource-id,Values=subnet-0a1b2c3d`

jonah: Also sent peering template to customer's firewall team; they asked for the BGP ASN example we use for TGW. I'm sharing sample config in INF-4442.

tara: Small policy excerpt (example, not prod): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"]}]}`

tara: Note: require explicit `sts:AssumeRole` trust to their account only. No wildcard principals.

nina: Pricing FYI: initial thumb rule for object-lock + 7y cold storage is ~+15% storage OPEX; will refine once we get GB/month.

alex: I'll draft the customer note framing the two options and include expected timelines. We should ask customer to prioritize compliance contact so legal can review the attestation language.

maria: Thanks all. I'll paste this into the Lazuli onboarding doc and follow up after the Friday sync. If blockers appear earlier, drop them here. :thumbsup:
